text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 343, dated August 24,
1950, is heresy amended by increasing and setting up new ceiling
prices for Sardines in Tomato Sauce and Reinforcing Steel Bars, as
FOODSTUFFS (IMPORTED)
FISH CANNED
Sardines in Tomato Sauce:
Tall Round Tin.
100/5-oz. P20.12/cs. P21.84/cs. P0.24/tin
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS (IMPORTED)
Reinforcing steel bars, plain round,
round corrugated, round and
square deformed, conformed U.
S. A. standard specification, new
billet steel ASTM A-15-39
0.30
0.30
0.30
0.33
5313

5314
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
SEc. 3. Section 1 of Executive Order No. 353, dated October
6, 1950, is hereby amended by increasing and setting up new ceiling
price for Liverspread, as follows:
MEAT CANNED OR PRESERVED
Liverspread

This Order shall take effect five days after its
promulgation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of November,
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
BLPIDIO QUIRIno
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
